title: Entrust Bio — request for promotional uplift, trial extension, and credits
text:
Entrust Bio — request for promotional uplift, trial extension, and credits

['From: Jenna Park <jenna@entrustbio.com>\\nTo: lukas_meyer@redwood.com\\nDate: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00\\nSubject: Quick ask — trial extension + credits for expanded PoC\\n\\nHi Lukas,\\n\\nThanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the demo was helpful and our ML team is already running a couple of inference tests. We’re having one internal ask from product: if we can extend the PoC window by two weeks and add an extra $8k of platform credits, we can include an additional dataset and finish the evaluation.\\n\\nShort summary of why:\\n- We discovered an edge-case workload (long-form clinical notes) that needs one more pass.\\n- Our compliance team needs an extra week for the security checklist to sign off on the VPC config.\\n\\nCan you confirm whether Redwood can:\\n1) extend trial end date from 11/30 -> 12/14;\\n2) provide a one-time $8,000 credit to cover extra token consumption during the extension; and\\n3) keep current demo pricing (no changes)?\\n\\nI’ve attached a CSV with the PoC usage so far. Procurement is standing by — they said they can route a quick MOU if we agree.\\n\\nAppreciate the help,\\nJenna\\nJenna Park\\nDirector, Product\\nEntrust Bio\\n\\nAttachment: Entrust_PoC_usage.csv (CSV, 27KB)', 'From: lukas_meyer@redwood.com\\nTo: Jenna Park <jenna@entrustbio.com>\\nCc: marissa_cole@redwood.com\\nDate: 2026-11-16T10:05:00-08:00\\nSubject: Re: Quick ask — trial extension + credits for expanded PoC\\n\\nHi Jenna — thanks for the note and the usage CSV (helpful).\\n\\nQuick update: the request is reasonable from a product fit perspective. I want to route an internal exception for the combined credit + extension (this is slightly above my playbook). Looping in Marissa to approve a one-time promotional uplift and to confirm contract language for the brief extension.\\n\\nOperationally:\\n- We can hold the demo pricing for the extension period (no changes).\\n- The $8k credit would be promotional (applied to hosted usage) and would not affect future baseline pricing.\\n- We’ll need an MOU or short-order form agreeing to the revised trial end date and credit usage; procurement@entrustbio can send that.\\n\\nMarissa — can you confirm whether $8k + 2-week extension needs exec sign-off or if we can greenlight from team? I captured the usage and impact below.\\n\\nEstimated impact to Redwood: ~$5k marginal cost (hosted tokens + infra) but increases likelihood of conversion by final evaluation.\\n\\nThanks,\\nLukas\\nAccount Executive, Redwood Inference\\n\\n[Quoted original message]\\n> From: Jenna Park <jenna@entrustbio.com>\\n> Date: 2026-11-15 09:12\\n> Subject: Quick ask — trial extension + credits for expanded PoC\\n>\\n> (see above)', 'From: marissa_cole@redwood.com\\nTo: lukas_meyer@redwood.com\\nCc: priyom_das@redwood.com\\nDate: 2026-11-16T13:42:00-08:00\\nSubject: Fwd: Entrust Bio credit & extension request — exec approval needed\\n\\nLukas — forwarding to Priyom for exec review. This is a high-probability mid-market deal; $8k credit for a short extension is within our playbook if we attach a 3-month conversion check or a nominal committed budget thereafter.\\n\\nSuggested terms for exec clearance:\\n- One-time promotional credit: $8,000 applied to hosted usage; expires 12/31/2026 if unused.\\n- Trial extended to 2026-12-14.\\n- MOU to include a conversion clause: if Entrust converts to a paid plan within 90 days after extension, Redwood will apply a $3,000 onboarding credit against their first invoice.\\n- No further discounts to list pricing without renewed exec review.\\n\\nRationale: small short-term revenue hit but increases conversion odds and gets procurement moving. If Priyom signs off I’ll draft the short MOU (MOU_draft_v2.pdf) and loop legal.\\n\\nMarissa\\nHead of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference\\n\\n-----Original Message-----\\nFrom: lukas_meyer@redwood.com\\nSent: Monday, November 16, 2026 10:05 AM\\nTo: Jenna Park <jenna@entrustbio.com>\\nCc: marissa_cole@redwood.com\\nSubject: Re: Quick ask — trial extension + credits for expanded PoC', 'From: priyom_das@redwood.com\\nTo: marissa_cole@redwood.com\\nCc: lukas_meyer@redwood.com\\nDate: 2026-11-18T09:23:00-08:00\\nSubject: Re: Entrust Bio credit & extension request — exec decision\\n\\nThanks for the summary — reviewed. Approve the one-time $8k promotional credit and a 2-week trial extension with the following conditions:\\n\\n1) MOU signed that documents the extension dates and credit application (legal review).\\n2) Entrust provides a short evaluation checklist (3 bullet points) confirming the clinical-notes workload test completion by 12/14.\\n3) If Entrust does not convert within 90 days post-extension, we close the promotional credit and do not commit to future concessions.\\n\\nMarissa: Please draft and send the MOU and coordinate with Legal. Lukas: confirm to Jenna and ask procurement to send the MOU to legal@redwood.com.\\n\\nPriyom\\nVP, Sales (Redwood Inference)\\n\\n> On Nov 16, 2026, at 1:42 PM, marissa_cole@redwood.com wrote:\\n> (see forward)', 'From: lukas_meyer@redwood.com\\nTo: Jenna Park <jenna@entrustbio.com>\\nCc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com\\nDate: 2026-11-21T18:42:00-08:00\\nSubject: Re: Entrust Bio — request for promotional uplift, trial extension, and credits\\n\\nHi Jenna — good news: Exec approval granted. Quick summary of agreed items and next steps: \\n\\nAgreed items:\\n- Trial extension: new end date 2026-12-14.\\n- One-time promotional credit: $8,000 applied to hosted token usage (applies during extension and expires 2026-12-31 if any balance remains).\\n- Conversion incentive: $3,000 onboarding credit applied to first invoice if Entrust converts within 90 days of the extended end date.\\n\\nNext steps:\\n1) Procurement — please send the short MOU or countersigned PO to procurement@redwood.com and copy legal@redwood.com (we attached our draft).\\n2) Entrust product team — please send the 3-point evaluation checklist when ready so we can track outcomes.\\n3) Lukas will apply the promo credit in the billing system and confirm once live.\\n\\nThanks all — happy to kick the extension on Monday morning once we have an MOU live.\\n\\nBest,\\nLukas Meyer\\nAccount Executive, Redwood Inference\\n\\nAttachment: MOU_draft_v2.pdf (PDF, 48KB)\\n\\n-----Original Message-----\\nFrom: priyom_das@redwood.com\\nSent: Wednesday, November 18, 2026 9:23 AM\\nTo: marissa_cole@redwood.com; lukas_meyer@redwood.com\\nSubject: Re: Entrust Bio credit & extension request — exec decision\\n\\n> (see above)']
